#Module forms

Form controls (HTML forms): values, checkedness, validity, selection, select / option / form members, focus, and FormData. Members shared by several interfaces are one function imported under each interface's name (HTMLInputElement_value, HTMLTextAreaElement_value...): it accepts any control and does what HTML says for its kind.

  • selection positions are UTF-16 code units, as in JavaScript; -1 means null (the API does not apply);
  • valueAsDate is milliseconds since the epoch, NaN for null;
  • events: InputEvent.data is Event_data, inputType Event_text; SubmitEvent.submitter, FocusEvent.relatedTarget and FormDataEvent.formData are Event_object.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/forms.widl.
